independence_status: Unverified, not evidence of dependence: the acquired HOSTS export has no bibliography or observation-date fields.

cuba.source: Fernandez-Hernandez DM and Minno MC (2015), Tropical Lepidoptera Research 25(1):8-14, printed p.10, visually verified from the official full PDF
cuba.field_locality: Sierra del Chorrillo, La Belen, Najasa, Cuba
cuba.limit: Egg hatch to adult, not egg laying to adult. A field-origin rearing observation, not untreated field survival; nine eggs are not a known homogeneous P. demoleus denominator. Nearby Triphasia nondetection is not proof of unusability. Las Tunas immatures identified as Heraclides andraemon are excluded.

lemon_name_trace.reason: Literal taxon-name matching misses the hybrid marker ×. The species-rank rule is not the reason for this particular omission.
lemon_name_trace.conditional_local_effect: If this single alias is deliberately reconciled, CUB known introduced hosts would rise from six to seven; CUB was already an added resource cell.
lemon_name_trace.boundary: Do not infer a novel host switch, substitute another Citrus species or silently correct the frozen +54.9%. Global effects of broader name reconciliation have not been evaluated.

Phillips2020_S1.boundary: Detection counts are inspections with insects, not individual survival. Regional winter/summer pupal dormancy and 2-4 annual generations are reported in the primary article, but S1 is not an egg-to-adult cohort dataset. No seasonal failure effect is estimated.

Neves2001_November_candidate: Still provisional: original table image unavailable; no denominator or complete follow-up. Do not equate reported nonemergence with verified mortality or causal low-temperature failure.
